title: About Heiz Bags
lead: Women's handbags from our pick-up point on Tom Mboya Street, Nairobi.
intro: Heiz Bags sells women's handbags, from mini handbags to laptop handbags. Pick up at Dynamic Mall, 5th floor, or ask about delivery.
